mode_text: Long+Short (1x paper) · Exit Arrows evaluated intrabar on the live price (up arrow closes a short and opens a long; down arrow closes a long and opens a short)
live_formula: long: value=units*price; short: value=max(2*collateral-units*price,0); unreal=value-cost; net_if_sold=value*(1-fee)-cost; bh=alloc*price/bh_c0; balance=pool.cash+sum(value)
